items.constraint: 所有 SIP UA 必须有办法保证其产生的 Call-ID 不会被任何其他 UA 意外生成

items.meaning: Retried requests prompted by failure responses that solicit an amendment to a request are not considered new requests and do not need new Call-ID header fields.
Use of cryptographically random identifiers in the generation of Call-IDs is RECOMMENDED.
items.constraint: Use of cryptographically random identifiers in the generation of Call-IDs is RECOMMENDED.
items.object: cryptographically random identifiers in the generation of Call-IDs

items.meaning: Implementations MAY use the form "localid@host".
items.constraint: Implementations MAY use the form "localid@host".

items.meaning: Call-IDs are case-sensitive and are simply compared byte-by-byte.
No provisioning or human interface is required for the selection of the Call-ID header field value for a request.
Further information on the Call-ID header field is in Section 20.8.
The CSeq header field serves as a way to identify and order transactions and consists of a sequence number and a method.
The method MUST match that of the request.
items.constraint: The method MUST match that of the request.

items.meaning: For non-REGISTER requests outside of a dialog, the sequence number value is arbitrary.
The sequence number value MUST be expressible as a 32-bit unsigned integer.
items.constraint: The sequence number value MUST be expressible as a 32-bit unsigned integer.

items.meaning: The sequence number value MUST be less than 2**31.
items.constraint: The sequence number value MUST be less than 2**31.

items.meaning: A client may use any mechanism it would like to select CSeq header field values, as long as it follows the above guidelines.
